card.name: Along, down, by after a verb
card.fires_on: Direction or route words such as along, down, across, and by right after a verb, where a path, line, or route of administration comes next.

modes.label: Path or line
modes.description: Along, down, or across before a line, river, or edge being followed.

modes.label: Route of giving
modes.description: The word by after give or administer, before a route like IV bolus or subcutaneous injection.
modes.example: Do not give<< by>> bolus injection.
